create_websocket_session: create a WebSocketSession with an ip, port, session_id, and enums object
start_websocket_session: start a WebSocketSession to launch a websocket server on the configured ip and port
stop_websocket_session: stop a running WebSocketSession by halting the event loop and joining the thread
write_websocket_data: write data to connected websocket clients via the async write method on WebSocketSession
review_websocket_session_class: review the WebSocketSession class and its start, stop, and write methods
